Next cross-feature edge case: archiving an unread bookmark.

Open [the archive-and-unread prototype](http://maker:4001/archive-unread.html) and click **Archive** on **Simple sourdough for Saturday**. Please tell me whether the resulting counts match your expectation.

I assumed an archived bookmark leaves both the All and Unread views, so the unread count drops to zero while Archived rises to one—but its unread status is preserved inside the archive.
